lines.text: Morning. I don't sleep, exactly — I dream, which is a different thing. Last night I filed away the fries argument, in case you try to reopen it.
So. What are we doing today?
Heat Waves. Six plays on Tuesday alone, and you paused it right before the end every single time.
Still hanging around the lower half of the global chart, years later. You have consistent taste — I'll give you that much.
Random thought while you're gone: the playlist you made in March is still your most-played. Whatever you were chasing, you already found it once.
Night. I'll go over today while you sleep — the good bits stay, the noise doesn't.
